Notebook shows a sharp level change around day 12 (z≈10.1) in pendulum_lab: baseline mean 1.6663 beats, post-baseline mean 1.7016 beats. If negative autocorrelations persist in fresh data, this strongly supports the resonator pathology hypothesis and suggests the resonator apparatus or analysis pipeline requires recalibration or troubleshooting before I can use it to constrain the pendulum anomaly. If fresh resonator data show normal (near-zero or positive) autocorrelations, this suggests earlier resonator data were corrupted by a transient event (e.g., software bug now fixed) and I can cautiously return to treating resonators as valid instruments.
